ext_if = "vio0"
int_if = "vio1"
iot_if = "vlan20"
table <servers> const { 192.168.1.10 192.168.1.11 }
table <bruteforce> persist
set block-policy drop
set state-policy floating
set optimization normal
set limit states 50000
set syncookies never
set skip on { lo }
set loginterface none
lan_net = "192.168.1.0/24"
tcp_services = "{ ssh, domain }"
table <martians> { 0.0.0.0/8 10.0.0.0/8 127.0.0.0/8 169.254.0.0/16 172.16.0.0/12 192.0.0.0/24 192.0.2.0/24 224.0.0.0/3 198.18.0.0/15 198.51.100.0/24 203.0.113.0/24 }
set loginterface egress
block drop all label "opf:builtin:default-block"
pass out inet all flags S/SA label "opf:builtin:self-out"
pass out inet6 all flags S/SA label "opf:builtin:self-out"
match in all scrub (no-df random-id max-mss 1440)
match out on egress inet from ! (egress:network) to any nat-to (egress:0) round-robin
block drop in quick on ! egress inet from 100.64.1.2/31 to any
block drop in quick inet from 100.64.1.3 to any
block drop in quick on ! vio1 inet from 192.168.50.0/24 to any
block drop in quick inet from 192.168.50.1 to any
block drop in quick on egress from <martians> to any
block return out quick on egress from any to <martians>
block drop all label "opf:rule:imp6"
pass out quick inet all flags S/SA label "opf:rule:imp7"
block drop in quick from <bruteforce> to any label "opf:rule:imp8"
pass in on egress inet proto tcp from any to (egress) port = 22 flags S/SA keep state (source-track rule, max-src-conn 15, max-src-conn-rate 5/3, overload <bruteforce> flush global, src.track 3) label "opf:rule:imp9"
pass in on egress inet proto tcp from any to (egress) port = 8080 flags S/SA rdr-to 192.168.1.10 port 80
pass in on vio1 inet all flags S/SA
pass in on vlan20 inet from any to ! 192.168.1.0/24 flags S/SA
